sections.heading: I am Đan
sections.lead: An Industrial Designer who believes every user need is worth finding out about properly.

body: I graduated in Industrial Design from Van Lang University. The way I work leans on product analysis and honest research: look hard at what already exists, ask real users, and only then propose a direction.
After four years of studying and working, what has stayed with me is discipline and persistence, along with an eye for the limits of a current product and how to push past them.
I treat each project as a chance to balance how something looks against how it works, so the result is useful and has a character of its own. Three words I like: try, learn, fix.
